title: Top 10 Things to Do in Phuket Old Town
content:
Phuket Old Town is a treasure trove of cultural heritage, stunning architecture, and authentic Thai experiences. Here are the top 10 things you must do when visiting this charming district.

1. Walk Along Thalang Road

The most iconic street in Old Town, Thalang Road showcases the best of Sino-Portuguese architecture. The colorful shophouses dating back to the 19th century create a perfect backdrop for photos.

2. Visit the Sunday Walking Street Market

Every Sunday evening, Thalang Road transforms into a vibrant night market. Sample local street food, shop for handicrafts, and enjoy live performances.

3. Explore the Shrine of Serene Light

This beautiful Chinese shrine, hidden down a narrow alley, offers a peaceful retreat from the bustling streets.

4. Discover Street Art

Phuket Old Town is home to numerous stunning murals and street art pieces that tell stories of local culture and history.

5. Try Local Coffee Shops

The area is dotted with charming cafes housed in restored shophouses, perfect for a relaxing afternoon break.
